phone.heading: Set up a phone
phone.step1: Start with a new phone, or factory-reset it (this erases it).
phone.step2: On the first Welcome screen, tap the same spot 6 times. A scanner opens.
phone.step3: Scan this code. The phone installs Thurea from this computer, and Thurea is in charge before the home screen appears.
phone.wifiOnShort: The phone connects by itself from the code
phone.wifiNoneShort: Not on Wi-Fi, or its password isn't readable: connect the phone yourself
phone.wifiOffShort: Left out: connect the phone to Wi-Fi yourself
keep.step1: On the phone: Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times. (Or plug it in by USB with USB debugging on, and skip to step 3.)
keep.step2: Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging: on → Pair device with QR code.
keep.step3: Scan this code. Thurea installs over Wi-Fi, signs your accounts out for a moment (Android needs that once), takes charge, then signs you back in.
keep.waiting: Waiting for the phone to scan (same Wi-Fi as this computer)
keep.signout: Signing out for a moment: %1. Confirm on the phone, and enter your PIN there if it asks.
keep.owner: Thurea is in charge of the phone. Signing your accounts back in…
keep.ownerFailed: Thurea couldn't take charge (%1). Signing your accounts back in.
keep.signin: Signing back in to %1: enter your password or use your passkey on the phone.
keep.signinSamsung: Add account is open on the phone: sign back in to your Samsung account (%1).
keep.signinLater: %1 isn't back yet: add it later in Settings → Accounts.
keep.apps: Open these apps once to sign back in: %1
keep.done: All done. Thurea is in charge, your accounts are back, and Wireless debugging is off again.
keep.updated: Thurea was already in charge of this phone. It's updated.
keep.note: Nothing on the phone is erased: apps, photos and settings stay. Thurea never types or sees your passwords.
